order: Score the initial forty-item corpus blind against the sealed reference pass, record the result against the pre-registered threshold of at least thirty-six of forty, and if the threshold is missed, redraw the class borders and apply the redraw to the plan. Diagnose the root cause of any concentrated disagreement pattern. Do not simply patch individual items in isolation. Add a precedence rule to the relevant preamble: recall signals are hints alone, and the requested work product plus the discriminator decide from intake text, not a signal word standing in for it; rename the affected column to match. Amend the discriminators implicated by the disagreements and confine any new discriminator to where a genuine gap is found, plus phase-ordering rules for diagnosis-before-implementation and composite orders. Record the reference pass, the disagreement ledger, the redraw, and a post-redraw resolution of every flagged item, explicit that this is a scoring reference and must never stand in as a validation.
claims: The blind pass scored 31 of 40 (77.5 percent) against the pre-registered threshold of at least thirty-six of forty, with two ambiguities at the cap and nine disagreements across nine distinct pairs — ten counting the ambiguity — none repeated, so no merge was forced. The redraw was applied, adding a precedence rule, amending discriminators, adding new ones only where needed, and introducing two phase rules.
